comments.author: Jonnia
comments.body:
Listen people, this is 100% verified by me:

Ambush (success) makes a x3 times more effective of getting the HASC than trying to obtain it without ambush aide skill.

Adding to that, having a 100 traits Cargo Seizure in your aide improves the chance of getting this item than doing by only Plunder skill.

To end this, having a R17 or R1 DOES NOT affect the drop rate of this item, so it doesnt matter the rank of plunder, unless you use Pillage Order or the Rare Item Plunder skill from college (or whatever the skill is named).

All of this was confirmed by GMBrewmaster.

IGN Jonnia
